streaming.liveText: Specification: Moment Diary Backend MVP (v2)This specification defines the backend-first MVP for "Moment Diary" using Bun, TypeScript, Hono, and SQLite.ScopeThe scope includes a complete RESTful API for diary management with user authentication. It covers user registration, login, diary CRUD, and a timeline view with filtering. No frontend is included.Technical StackRuntime: BunFramework: HonoDatabase: SQLite (via bun:sqlite)Language: TypeScriptData ModelDatabase Pathdata/moment-diary.dbTablesusersid: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENTemail: TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULLpassword_hash: TEXT NOT NULLcreated_at: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMPsessionstoken: TEXT PRIMARY KEYuser_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)created_at: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMPdiary_entriesid: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENTuser_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)title: TEXTcontent: TEXT NOT NULLmood: TEXTis_favorite: INTEGER DEFAULT 0 (boolean 0/1)created_at: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMPupdated_at: DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMPtagsid: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENTuser_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id)name: TEXT NOT NULL (original case)normalized_name: TEXT NOT NULL (lowercase for deduplication)UNIQUE(user_id, normalized_name)diary_tagsdiary_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES diary_entries(id) ON DELETE CASCADEtag_id: INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tags(id) ON DELETE CASCADEPRIMARY KEY(diary_id, tag_id)API EndpointsAuthenticationPOST /auth/register: { email, password } -> { id, email }POST /auth/login: { email, password } -> { token }DiariesPOST /diaries: Create entry. Accepts title, content, mood, is_favorite, tags (string array).GET /diaries: List user's entries.GET /diaries/:id: Get specific entry with tags.PATCH /diaries/:id: Update entry. Refresh updated_at.DELETE /diaries/:id: Delete entry and associated diary_tags.TimelineGET /timeline: Paginated list of entries.Sort: created_at DESCParams: tag (filter by tag name), mood (filter by mood), limit (default 20), offset (default 0).Implementation DetailsFile Structuresrc/app.ts: Hono app entry point and route registration.src/db/connection.ts: SQLite connection initialization.src/db/schema.ts: DDL statements and table creation logic.src/auth/service.ts: User and session logic (password hashing, token generation).src/auth/routes.ts: Hono routes for auth.src/diary/service.ts: Diary and tag logic (CRUD, deduplication).src/diary/routes.ts: Hono routes for diaries.src/timeline/routes.ts: Hono route for timeline.src/middleware/auth.ts: Bearer token validation middleware.Security & Business RulesPasswords: Use Bun.password.hash (defaulting to argon2 or bcrypt) for storage.Authentication: Authorization: Bearer <token> header required for all protected routes.Authorization: Every query MUST include WHERE user_id = ? to prevent cross-user access.Tags: Tags are scoped to users. Normalize to lowercase for the normalized_name column to ensure uniqueness within a user's scope.Cascading: Deleting a diary entry MUST delete its relationships in diary_tags.Acceptance CriteriaBuild: bunx tsc --noEmit passes without errors.Tests: bun test passes with coverage for:Password hashing verification.Successful registration and login (returning token).CRUD operations restricted to owner.Timeline filtering by tag and mood.updated_at refreshing on PATCH.Cleanup of diary_tags on entry deletion.Behavior:Non-authenticated requests to /diaries return 401.Accessing another user's diary returns 404 or 403.GET /timeline returns 20 items by default.

├── app.ts                # Application entry and route wiring
├── auth/
│   ├── routes.ts         # Auth endpoints
│   └── service.ts        # Hashing and session logic
├── db/
│   ├── connection.ts     # SQLite initialization
│   └── schema.ts         # DDL and table creation
├── diary/
│   ├── routes.ts         # Diary CRUD endpoints
│   └── service.ts        # Diary and Tag logic
├── middleware/

└── timeline/

test/
